hooks.name: Close home-ops-553 when MariaDB backups merge to main

action.command: set -e; cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || echo .)"; ISSUE=home-ops-553; FEAT=8e812b3; command -v bd >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; git fetch origin main --quiet 2>/dev/null || exit 0; if ! git merge-base --is-ancestor "$FEAT" origin/main 2>/dev/null; then exit 0; fi; STATUS=$(bd show "$ISSUE" --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin);print((d[0] if isinstance(d,list) else d).get('status',''))" 2>/dev/null || echo ""); if [ "$STATUS" = "closed" ]; then exit 0; fi; bd close "$ISSUE" 2>/dev/null && echo "Closed $ISSUE: MariaDB S3 backups commit $FEAT is now merged into origin/main."
